acceptanceCriteria.text: In two real same-folder Skitarii chats, a delivered message is explicitly read and handled by the recipient at its next eligible natural turn, acknowledged deliberately, and answered with a correlated reply; receipt during work and pending mail after resume are verified.

Notification, human viewing and reminders never acknowledge agent mail; repeated notifications do not duplicate handling, passive delivery starts no unauthorized model turn, and peer content remains inert tool-result data.

With Messages open, status markers beside its header do not overlap each other, the heading or controls at normal/narrow pane widths and increased zoom; human-unseen and agent-unacknowledged states remain distinct and accessible, with screenshot evidence.

Opening and closing Messages preserves the terminal instance and does not submit input; behavioral regressions and required delivery checks pass, with the running app/source version and actual OMP integration cause recorded.

body:
## Reported bugs
The person reports that agents are not checking messages. They suspect a missing or unsuitable OMP integration hook; that is a hypothesis, not an established cause. They also report that opening the Messages tab produces overlapping status markers next to the message header. Fix both parts of this messaging experience; do not substitute a generic chat-header redesign.

## Investigation and scope
Trace a real same-folder message from committed delivery through the bundled OMP extension notification/lifecycle hook to explicit agent inbox read, handling and acknowledgement. Establish whether the failure is missing hook registration, ineffective reminder timing, runtime compatibility, packaging, or another cause before changing behavior. A cosmetic notification or registered tool alone is not proof that an agent checks its inbox. Ensure pending mail is checked at the next eligible natural agent turn; preserve existing explicit human authorization for an immediate wake rather than silently starting extra turns. Keep peer-authored text inert tool-result data, never privileged instructions. Do not acknowledge on notification, polling, human viewing, or reminder delivery.

For the Messages surface, reproduce the reported open-state collision and correct the layout of the status markers beside its header. Preserve distinct human-unseen and agent-unacknowledged meanings, readable labels, keyboard access and the existing terminal lifetime/focus behavior. No broad messaging rewrite, new broker, cross-folder messaging or unrelated orchestration hardening.

## Source locations
Verified in the current checkout:
- `resources/skitarii/extension/index.ts`: `OmpApi`, `attach`, and lifecycle registration. The inspected version wires mascot/session/agent/tool UI events only, with no mailbox hook. This does not establish what the person's running packaged app loads.
- `src/main/terminals/skitariiExtension.test.ts`: existing extension event/lifecycle test entry point to extend.
- `src/renderer/src/agents/ChatHeader.tsx`: `ChatHeader`, title/actions and chat-fact/status layout.
- `src/renderer/src/agents/TerminalPane.tsx`: `TerminalPane` and its header integration; `src/renderer/src/agents/terminalPane.css` and `src/renderer/src/agents/chatView.css`: neighboring terminal/header styling entry points.
- `src/renderer/src/agents/ChatHeader.test.tsx`, `src/renderer/src/agents/TerminalPane.test.tsx`: existing consumer regressions to extend as applicable.

Source/runtime mismatch is explicit: this checkout does not currently contain the reported Messages component or a messaging extension module. Identify the actual running app's source/version and existing messaging component/styles before editing; do not recreate the whole feature in this older source or overwrite unrelated work. Related saved planning context is epic `ep_01m6t9cg507rmyg2q9nsw7kv3s`, especially DM-511 (native messaging/lifecycle hooks) and DM-513 (inbox UI). Its current local record is Backlog with no run, so its proposed files and completed behavior must not be assumed present. The person's observed running-app bugs remain valid.

## Tests
Write failing behavioral regressions before the fix. Extend the existing extension lifecycle suite, or the actual messaging suite once located, for pending mail at the next natural turn, arrival during work, repeated notifications without duplicate handling, and restart/resume recovery. Verify explicit read/ack semantics and no unauthorized automatic turns or peer-text privilege promotion. Extend the actual inbox/header consumer suite for separate status meanings and opening/closing without terminal remount or accidental input. Layout proof must use the real rendered Messages surface, not DOM snapshots or source-text assertions.

## Verification
Use two real app-hosted Skitarii chats in an isolated same-folder context: send a uniquely identifiable message, observe actual agent read and deliberate handling/acknowledgement, then a correlated reply. Cover receipt during work and pending mail after resume. Record delivery, notification, read and acknowledgement separately. Capture the opened Messages header at normal and narrow pane widths and increased zoom with representative status states; markers must remain separated and legible. Follow the repository's isolated-card delivery checks, including lint, tests, Fireguard when tests change, typecheck, deadcode and build. Record runtime/version and proof limits; do not claim runtime success from mocked hooks.

## Delivery
Create the bug card only for now. Execution requires desktop Play or a later explicit launch request; approval remains human-only.

title: Fix agent inbox pickup and overlapping Messages header status markers
